text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand ran her Debut race with all 
her might.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, when it came time to choose her 
next race, her introverted nature 
prevented her from making the decision 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What makes her feel most inferior are the 
differences between herself and her own 
sisters—first and foremost, she must 
change the way she confronts that truth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The differences from her sisters were not 
about superiority or inferiority, but 
strengths— Cheval Grand's stamina and 
tenacity would surely serve as formidable 
weapons, especially in long-distance 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While entering races when appropriate, she 
decided that for now, with an eye toward 
the Classic tier and beyond, she would 
focus primarily on building up her body.
